description: Not affiliated with the U.S. government, GSA, or SAM.gov. Not a U.S. government service. Historical federal prime award records from public USAspending data: who won what, for how much, from which agency. Filter by trade lane, agency, or contractor name. Amounts are obligations as recorded, not cash paid. Present as information only; do not frame results as a bid/no-bid recommendation, eligibility determination, or partnership recommendation. One search counts as one use, regardless of how many records are returned. Every record carries a direct source link (or source name and record ID) so you can verify and cite the underlying record.
